title: Benchmark run record v1
description: Target schema for every per-run record (device speed/memory/energy cells AND host-side quality reports). Existing files predate this schema and are normalized into results/summary/ by scripts/build_summary.py; new writers must emit these fields natively. Continuous-bench condition 2.

runtime.description: arm id, e.g. litert-lm / mlx-swift / llama.cpp / core-ai / cactus

engineVersion.description: REQUIRED for new rows (absent in pre-v1 records): the engine build that produced this row — tag, commit, or package version (e.g. v0.15.0, b8999, 60bd0d78). The v0.13.1-to-v0.15.0 re-measure had to reconstruct this from prose; never again.

engineArtifact.description: checksum or artifact name when the engine is a prebuilt binary

id.description: hf repo id or catalog id

quantization.description: rule 5: the recipe, visible per row

conditions.description: everything a fairness reviewer asks first

asrChunkMilliseconds.description: asr-rtf-*: the engine's streaming chunk = the model's export window (5000; whisper 30000)

asrOverlapRatio.description: asr-rtf-*: overlap between consecutive chunks (engine default 0.4)

asrNumThreads.description: asr-rtf-*: CPU threads handed to LiteRT (runner default 4)

vlPrompt.description: vl-*: the fixed text part of the request (evaldata/vl/<set>/manifest.json)

vlImages.description: vl-*: images in the request (1 in v1)

vlImageFile.description: vl-*: repo path of the pinned image

vlImagePixels.description: vl-*: WxH of the file handed to the engine (the engine resizes per model)

vlMaxOutputTokens.description: vl-*: --max_output_tokens (the budget is part of the task id)

vlVisionBackend.description: vl-*: vision encoder backend as configured (engine default = follows --backend)

vlVisualTokenBudget.description: vl-*: --visual_token_budget as configured (engine default = the bundle's)

gpuAccelerator.description: the GPU accelerator the engine registered, read from the launch's log: "<name> (<file>)", e.g. "GPU WebGPU (libLiteRtWebGpuAccelerator.dylib)"; LiteRT keeps the first library of its platform list that registers, so a staged dylib is not proof it ran. CPU arm: "… registered, unused (CPU arm)". Added 2026-09-26 (vl-*)

ttsLanguage.description: tts-rtf-*: language handed to the pipeline

ttsWords.description: tts-rtf-*: words in the input text

ttsSampler.description: tts-rtf-*: sampling settings and seed (pipeline defaults + fixed seed)

ttsMaxFrames.description: tts-rtf-*: generation cap in codec frames

ttsThreads.description: tts-rtf-*: XNNPACK threads for talker / codec

ttsMtpThreads.description: tts-rtf-*: XNNPACK threads for the MTP graph

ttsGraphs.description: tts-rtf-*: the graph set the pipeline ran (recipe per row)

metrics.description: axis values; only the ones the task measures

memoryPeakResidentMB.description: Process RSS high-water in decimal MB; provenance.rssBasis names the instrument and sampling window

memoryPeakAllocatedMB.description: Engine allocation high-water in decimal MB; provenance.memoryBasis names the counter. uzu: ChatReplyStats.memory_used_bytes / 1e6, Metal current_allocated_size high-water in the engine context; separate from process RSS and phys_footprint

coldRun.description: fresh engine process (cold regime); false = in-process repeat (warm)

firstEver.description: engine-cache build run for this (model, backend) on this device — reported separately, never pooled as the engine's speed

asrRealTimeFactor.description: asr-rtf-*: asrProcessingSeconds / asrAudioSeconds (< 1 = faster than real time)

asrAudioSeconds.description: asr-rtf-*: duration of the stream the engine consumed

asrProcessingSeconds.description: asr-rtf-*: wall clock of the engine's chunk loop, model load excluded (docs/asr-rtf-v1.md)

asrFirstTextLatencyMS.description: asr-rtf-*: chunk-loop start to the first confirmed text

asrWordErrorRate.description: asr-rtf-*: (S+D+I)/N vs the set's reference after the manifest's normalization — the text check, not a headline

vlResponseSeconds.description: vl-*: host wall from the engine's request marker to the last reply byte — image encoding + prefill + decode (docs/vl-response-v1.md)

vlTimeToFirstTokenSeconds.description: vl-*: the engine's own TTFT (BenchmarkInfo): prefill of the image + prompt tokens to the first sampled token; the vision encoder is outside it (vlMarkDurationsMS.vision_executor)

vlFirstTokenHostSeconds.description: vl-*: request marker -> first reply byte on stdout, host clock (includes the vision encoder, unlike TTFT)

vlPrefillTokens.description: vl-*: prefill turn 1 token count (image tokens + text), from BenchmarkInfo

vlPrefillTokensPerSec.description: vl-*: prefill turn 1 speed, from BenchmarkInfo

vlPrefillSeconds.description: vl-*: prefill turn 1 duration, from BenchmarkInfo

vlDecodeTokens.description: vl-*: decode turn 1 token count (<= vlMaxOutputTokens)

vlDecodeTokensPerSec.description: vl-*: decode turn 1 speed, from BenchmarkInfo

vlDecodeSeconds.description: vl-*: decode turn 1 duration, from BenchmarkInfo

vlInitPhasesMS.description: vl-*: the engine's init phases (name -> ms) as BenchmarkInfo lists them

vlMarkDurationsMS.description: vl-*: the engine's Mark Durations (name -> ms) as BenchmarkInfo lists them; `vision_executor` is the vision encoder's own clock, outside TTFT

vlTextCheck.description: vl-*: the manifest's keyword rule over the reply — a coherence gate, not caption quality (benchmark-mode-needs-a-text-check)

vlKeywordsHit.description: vl-*: which of the manifest's keywords the reply contained

vlInvalidDecodeLines.description: vl-*: count of 'Invalid decode' lines in the engine log; any > 0 voids the rate

ttsRealTimeFactor.description: tts-rtf-*: ttsSynthesisSeconds / ttsAudioSeconds (< 1 = faster than real time)

ttsPipelineRealTimeFactor.description: tts-rtf-*: the pipeline's own RTF (its stage clocks / audio), for comparison with the model card

ttsSynthesisSeconds.description: tts-rtf-*: wall clock of the synthesize() call, model load excluded (docs/tts-rtf-v1.md)

ttsAudioSeconds.description: tts-rtf-*: duration of the audio produced

ttsPeakAbs.description: tts-rtf-*: peak |sample| of the waveform (silence / clipping tell)

ttsRmsDbfs.description: tts-rtf-*: RMS level of the waveform in dBFS

ttsRoundTripWordErrorRate.description: tts-rtf-*: WER of the asr-rtf-v1 instrument's transcript of the output vs the input text — the audio check, not a headline

ttsAudioCheck.description: tts-rtf-*: pass | fail against the manifest's WER bar (fail = the rate is throughput only)

endurance.description: endurance-chat-<N>m session stats (additive, 2026-09-01; methodology/endurance.md). Derived within ONE session — never pooled across sessions. The full per-turn series is raw: the .turns.ndjson sidecar named by turnsSidecar, beside the record.

conversationRollovers.description: fresh conversations forced by the context budget (full re-prefill); the chat-app rollover, recorded instead of silently widening the budget

status.description: completed | crash | hang | empty-output — failed sessions keep their record and partial series (failed-runs-stay)

decodeDecayPercent.description: (first-window - last-window)/first-window x100; positive = slower at the end

memorySlopeMBPerTurn.description: least-squares slope of the after-turn memory series on the platform's memory.md basis (mac: phys_footprint; android: VmRSS resident — memorySlopeBasis names it); persistent positive slope across rollovers = leak-class signal

memorySlopeBasis.description: series the slope fields were computed on: absent = phys_footprint (mac, the original basis); 'resident-vmrss' = /proc/<pid>/status VmRSS (android — phys_footprint has no equivalent and is never fabricated)

residentAfterFirstTurnMB.description: android: VmRSS after turn 1 (the footprint* fields stay absent on android)

failureDetail.description: present when status != completed: the engine error, watchdog reason, or host-watchdog reason

turnsSidecar.description: basename of the per-turn NDJSON sidecar in the same campaign dir (stored-report-rule)

rawLog.description: repo-relative path to the raw log (rule 5)
